title: Live trade management (LTR + strategy exits) correctness audit after the phantom-giveback incident: every input, trigger, pricing table, decision and apply verified against venue truth
note: Operator 2026-11-26 chat, verbatim: "let me know when we figure out why we had that kind of mistake with the LTR. That seems like it could be symptomatic of a much larger problem affecting more trades, and we need to make sure that that function is working correctly." Known root cause (LTR-PHANTOM-GIVEBACK-PRE-ENTRY-BARS): ml_entry stamps meta.entry_time = decision-bar OPEN; since_entry keeps the bar containing entry_time. Scope of this audit: (1) every consumer of entry_time / opened_at / since_entry, not just LTR telemetry: strategy exit_levers (trails, structure exits), max_hold_min time stops (would fire ~1 bar early), TP revision, grading R, live_bar, LTR packet chart.since_entry, desk handoff; list which strategies stamp entry_time differently from the fill; (2) every LTR trigger (giveback, new_peak, adverse_r, near_target, mechanics, judgement_cadence) checked on a sample against venue fills; (3) the priced-options tables: is the hold/close population matched to the trade state or the whole leg population (reviewer flagged this on 11-26); (4) apply path: applied vs venue readback (cf LTR-PROP-CLOSE-FALSE-APPLIED); (5) the 31 15m could_not_look rows from the audit; (6) packet health history (degraded/could_not_price rates). Output: a findings table with n per check, each defect fixed or a row; report to the manager for the operator. Check 1 result (ML-PRIMARY 16:57Z, code read; trade impact not yet measured): every candle strategy stamps meta.entry_time = SIGNAL bar OPEN (trend_donchian*, fade_breakout_4h, squeeze_breakout_4h, htf_pullback_trend_2h, fvg_range_15m, ict_scalp, ml_entry); clean: claude_desk, ml_entry_eq. Defect A (order path): exit_levers.since_entry keeps the signal bar, so live Chandelier trail extremes include the pre-fill signal-bar wick; backtest_trend.py starts ext=entry and walks bars after the signal bar -> live trail can sit TIGHTER than the evidence when the signal-bar wick exceeds post-fill extremes; binds at wick >= (trail_mult - atr_stop_mult) x ATR: most exposed mes_trend_long_1d (0.5 ATR), tlt_pullback_1h, mhg_pullback_1d, squeeze_breakout_4h, trend_donchian_eth_prop, scha_trend_long_1d, eth_pullback_prop_2h (1.0 ATR). Defect B: ml_entry 24h time stop fires ~1 bar early (max_hold_verdict from entry_time). Fix: anchor = latest(meta.entry_time, package created_at) in since_entry and max_hold_verdict; held Tier-2 PR with a replay of recent trail-leg trades (with vs without signal bar). Manager decision: data-backed correctness fix (live made to match the backtest evidence); ship on green CI + replay, notify operator. 2026-11-26 ~18:20Z ML-PRIMARY FINDINGS (all six checks; population base reviews.jsonl 846 rows 10-25..11-26, 475 tables). (1a) trail window incl. pre-fill signal bar: 1,125 trail pkgs since 10-27, 5 diverged, 1 filled (pkg-2191e2c1 <=1.08R tighter, closed), 0 of 9 open -> FIXED #29249 (held; widen-only, no stop moves on deploy). (1b) ml_entry time stop ~1 bar early -> FIXED #29249. (1c) LTR peak/giveback from pre-fill bars: 5 of 87 measurable action reviews (4 ml_entry, 1 ict_scalp_eth_15m) -> FIXED #29238. (1d) 13 other entry_time readers: at parity or fill-anchored, no defect. (2) trigger inputs vs venue fills: 239 pkg x account pairs behind 701 trigger reviews; plan-vs-fill 125 equal / 92 <0.10R / 22 0.10-0.25R / 0 >=0.25R; plan basis before 11-15 for 224 unlabelled Bybit fills (fixed ENTRY-FILL-OPEN-R-BASIS 11-15) and Alpaca late fills (fixed #29165 + backfill #29253 today, 12 rows). (3) options population vs state: 157 measured tables 10-29..11-15 priced HOLD on the reached-peak population while >=0.25R below peak (148 hold recs) -> fixed 11-15 state conditioning; 3 manual residuals 11-19; since 11-20 30/30 ok. (4) applied vs readback (rows_watch.jsonl complete, 56 dispatched / 79 account outcomes): Bybit/Alpaca 52/52 closes journal-closed within 1h, 13/13 tightens venue_after == level; PROP VM 13 applies report verified_readback from the TICKET not the venue -> unverified, known defect LTR-PROP-CLOSE-FALSE-APPLIED still queued (ESCALATED to manager 18:05Z). (5) 31 15m rows re-measured on Binance USD-M 15m: 31/31 measured, 1 contaminated (applied close helped by 0.12R). (6) packet health: 200 of 362 reviews carry >=1 defect (could_not_price 70, open_r null 46, evidence_missing 37, insufficient_n 35, candles_missing 28) -> carried by LTR-GRADER-COVERAGE / LTR-PACKET-FIXES. Open defects: prop readback only. Full table: ML-PRIMARY report to Manager 26a.
